notes: Mobile Cycle 2 (M4) at 3.21.0: the git phone pack. Git account tokens on Android now live in a Keystore-encrypted store (Settings, Git accounts): the page can save a token and ask whether one exists, but can never read it back, and the on-device server resolves it by remote host at git time - nothing is written into a repo, a remote URL, or page storage, and a token saved by the old panel flow is moved into the store automatically. Clones are shallow by default (depth 1, one branch) with a Full clone opt-in, on both servers. The conflict editor gains a card view at phone widths (one block per card, ours/base/theirs stacked, same choices and save path), and the phone server gains the D9 conflict endpoints and status fields it was missing. Mobile Cycle 1 (M5) at 3.20.0: the Android app checks itself for updates - a separate android-latest.json manifest on the downloads host, compared by versionCode against the installed build (read from the package manager into /api/health). A newer build raises a dismissible banner whose Download button hands the APK to the system browser; the app never downloads or installs anything itself. Automatic checks run at most once a day, Later snoozes one version, and every failure is silent unless you check by hand. Mobile Cycle 1 (M3) at 3.19.0: a slim symbol row docks under the editor at phone widths while it has focus - Tab, brackets, quotes and the everyday code symbols in one sideways-scrolling row, with Undo and cursor keys; bracket and quote keys insert through the editor's own auto-close, so pairs land with the cursor inside. The key set and an on/off toggle live in Settings, Phone. A touch pass lifts tab close buttons, view bar items, panel header buttons and Git row buttons to a 40px minimum target on phones. The M1 viewport gate now also proves the row: it appears on focus, inserts, measures clean, and hides on blur. Mobile Cycle 1 (M1) at 3.18.0 added the viewport-matrix gate and phone layout hardening. Desktop 3.17.0 added git depth (hunk staging, three-pane conflict editor); 3.15.0 the neural embeddings index; 3.14.0 MCP polish; 3.12.0 language servers.
